scope: All 66 planter-only parent-versus-alternative roots of the existing signed 108-root panel, exactly matched to the archived stay-versus-move financial records by path, seed, seat, step, terrain and unchanged enemy order. Take intention-to-treat stay minus move even if no purchase occurs. Never choose an arm using its observed return.
public_definitions: Root tile under focal planter; empty of bases and trees; rich when all four adjacent carbon fields in focal seat's current observation are visible and total at least 120 (existing midgame plant definition); safe when no enemy worker can reach the root within one step in toroidal Manhattan distance. Middle period t100..199 inclusive. Read these conditions before examining either continuation.
outcomes: For each action arm sum every tree absorption divided into pure ground (total minus actual cargo-tax component) and cargo tax separately to both physical owners. Full remaining episode, and t100..199 separately (the middle-period amount ends before t200). Compute changes in own minus opponent ground income and in full official terminal score margin. Positive, negative, mixed and ties retained. Focal first-tenure net (ground only minus fee) is secondary.
coverage: Keep existing 48 training / 16 previously held / 2 outside assignment. Diagnostics include map means, seats, root counts, number with simultaneous gains/losses and quantitative counterexamples. A category earns only a provisional both-endpoint replication verdict if >=2 independent train maps and >=2 held maps, each split has both physical seats, >=2/3 train and held maps have positive mean changes on BOTH the midgame net ground balance and whole-game official score, with both signed metrics map-weighted positive in train/held and both physical seats directionally positive in held. Exposed archival splits, one opponent random continuation per arm; no causal generalization to the current first-win package.
no_execution: No new game, search call, policy change, training or held-test seed use.
